description: STEP 1 of brand onboarding (manual path — no website crawl). Creates a new brand from user-supplied name/description, sets it as active, then RETURNS a `nextStep` payload telling you to ask the user which platforms they publish on. After the user answers, call `set_brand_mediums` with their picks. Ask the user for a description if they did not provide one — onboarding will fail without it.
name: create_brand
